# Mac Theme Portfolio

> A Mac theme portfolio and a Windows 11 theme portfolio, both built in Flutter by Hamad Anwar.

Hamad Anwar publishes an interactive desktop portfolio at https://hamad-anwar.vercel.app/.

## What is this Mac theme portfolio?

A Mac theme portfolio is a personal website that looks and works like a Mac desktop. This one opens in the browser with a menu bar, a dock, draggable windows, photos, projects, and a terminal. It is built in Flutter.

## Windows 11 theme portfolio

The same site includes a Windows 11 theme portfolio. You can switch from the Mac desktop to a Windows 11 desktop with a taskbar, Start menu, and draggable windows.

## Who made it?

Hamad Anwar (also known as Hammad Anwar), a Flutter developer in Lahore, Pakistan.
